title: SegaSaturn FDD Operator
native_title: セガサターン ＦＤＤオペレーター
overview:
A data management utility for the Saturn Floppy Disk Drive, supplied on CD-ROM with the drive. With it you can copy and move save files between the console's internal memory, a backup memory cartridge and 3.5-inch floppy disks.

Each double-sided floppy appears as two separate storage areas, giving far more room than the internal memory or a cartridge. The utility runs from the disc, so it must be booted on its own rather than alongside a game.
